title: VitronEdit: Universal Visual Editing across Images, Videos, and 3D Scenes
title_zh: VitronEdit：跨图像、视频与3D场景的通用视觉编辑

paragraphs.en: VitronEdit提出统一图像、视频与3D场景编辑的通用框架，通过共享序列表示、渐进多模态训练与几何感知后训练实现跨模态编辑知识迁移。 Recent advances in unified visual editing have begun to consolidate image and video editing within a single model, while 3D scene editing remains largely separate and constrained by scarce paired training data. Given the rich image and video editing supervision now available and the common editing semantics shared across modalities, a natural question is whether this knowledge can be transferred to data-scarce 3D editing. We present VitronEdit, a universal framework for image, video, and 3D scene editing. VitronEdit adopts a shared sequence representation and progressive multimodal training to transfer editing knowledge across modalities. We further introduce geometry-aware post-training, which leverages a pretrained geometry reconstruction model to provide depth and camera-pose supervision. Surprisingly, applying geometric supervision only to 3D samples yields the best overall performance, while image and video editing also improve despite receiving no direct geometric supervision, suggesting that geometric regularization transfers through the shared backbone. Our analysis further shows that image and video training mainly transfers editing semantics to 3D, whereas 3D supervision primarily improves multi-view consistency. The project page: https://vitron-llm.github.io/VitronEdit/.
paragraphs.zh: VitronEdit 提出统一图像、视频与3D场景编辑的通用框架，通过共享序列表示、渐进多模态训练与几何感知后训练实现跨模态编辑知识迁移。近来统一视觉编辑的进展已开始在单一模型内整合图像与视频编辑，而3D场景编辑仍在很大程度上独立发展，并受制于稀缺的成对训练数据。 鉴于当前已有丰富的图像与视频编辑监督信号，且各模态间共享共同的编辑语义，一个自然的问题是：这些知识能否迁移到数据稀缺的3D编辑中。 我们提出 VitronEdit，一个面向图像、视频与3D场景编辑的通用框架。 VitronEdit 采用共享序列表示与渐进多模态训练，在模态间迁移编辑知识。 我们进一步引入几何感知后训练，利用预训练的几何重建模型提供深度与相机位姿监督。 出人意料的是，仅对3D样本施加几何监督即可获得最佳整体性能，而图像与视频编辑尽管未接受直接的几何监督，性能也有所提升，这表明几何正则化可通过共享骨干网络进行迁移。 我们的分析进一步表明，图像与视频训练主要向3D迁移编辑语义，而3D监督则主要提升多视角一致性。 项目页面：https://vitron-llm.github.io/VitronEdit/。
